title: Which push service fits a team of two
about: Five services compared on cost, delivery on a phone and setup time. Two fit; one is free up to our size.

sections.heading: Which push service, and why now
sections.body: The app needs a push for new answers before the beta on 1 Nov.

sections.heading: Phones only, under 100 people
sections.body: In: Android and iOS pushes for a team of two. Out: email and SMS.

sections.heading: Docs, issues and one test push each
sections.body: I read each service's docs and open issues, and sent one test push to a phone.

sections.heading: Five sources, one of them users
sections.body: Three primary sources and two user reports.

items.title: ntfy issue: iOS delivery
items.text: Users report delays on iOS without the relay.

sections.heading: Two options on the same axes
sections.body: Both deliver in under 2 seconds on Android.

items.title: Pushover
items.more:
Cost: $5 per platform.
Setup: ten minutes.

sections.heading: ntfy is free and fast enough

items.title: Delivery under 2 seconds
items.text: Timed on one Android phone, 10 pushes.

items.title: iOS needs the relay
items.text: Reported in an open issue; not timed by me.

sections.heading: iOS was not timed
sections.body: I had no iPhone; Reddit blocked fetching.

sections.heading: Use ntfy; Pushover is the runner-up
sections.body: ntfy is free at our size; Pushover if self-hosting is too much.

sections.heading: Who runs the server
sections.body: Self-hosting needs an owner for updates.
